caption: The tenant asks for 20 hosts of 16 vCPU and 64 GB: 320 vCPU and 1,280 GB. Admission control weighs that against the whole building, 1,200 cores and 12,800 GB, not against one host — 26.7% of the CPU and 10.0% of the RAM are in use, so the virtual data centre is accepted and the oversubscription ratio is 0.27, below 1.

spec.title: Worked example: 50 hosts of 24 cores and 256 GB, one tenant asks for 20 hosts of 16 vCPU and 64 GB
spec.aria: A physical data centre of 50 hosts at 24 cores and 256 GB gives 1,200 cores and 12,800 GB; the tenant's request of 20 hosts at 16 vCPU and 64 GB gives 320 vCPU and 1,280 GB; admission control compares them, gets 26.7% CPU and 10.0% RAM use, and accepts with oversubscription ratio 0.27.
